tweet.text:
🔥 BREAKTHROUGH IN GENETICS & OPEN SOURCE: WE'VE CRACKED THE HIDDEN SYNTAX INSIDE GENES! NOT A THEORETICAL SIMULATION - VALIDATED ON REAL GENOMES DIRECTLY FROM THE NCBI REFSEQ DATABASE! 🔥

Friends and colleagues! Jean-Claude Perez (@JCPEREZCODEX) and I are thrilled to announce the results of a monumental study that fundamentally shifts our understanding of the genetic code. Our new preprint: "From Form to Program: Medium-Range Conditional Codon Syntax Inside Real Genes".

Simply put: we are used to thinking of DNA as just a passive "hard drive" storing protein blueprints. But our data proves that humans and all living organisms are literally biological computers. There is a unified operating system running inside our genes!

🧬 FROM FORM TO PROGRAM: WHAT DID PEREZ DISCOVER AND WHAT DID WE PROVE?

In 2013, Jean-Claude Perez made a breakthrough by discovering the Form (Statics) of DNA-a hidden mathematical symmetry of 32 reverse-complement codon pairs. He proved the genome isn't a random soup of letters; it possesses perfect structural form.

But today, we take the next massive step. We've discovered the Program (Dynamics). We found a hidden conditional syntax inside real genes-strict rules dictating how one codon mathematically predetermines the next. This cannot be explained by basic biochemistry or static symmetry alone. It is like reading the source code of an operating system. It is a unified, mathematically precise signature-metaphorically speaking, we've caught a glimpse of the "Creator's handwriting" coding life itself.

And most importantly: THIS IS NOT A SIMULATION ON FAKE DATA. We analyzed the real thing!

To prove the existence of this "Program," we ran an unprecedented dataset of real genomes from 13 species across the tree of cellular life: from mammals (human T2T, chimp, mouse) and vertebrates (zebrafish, chicken) to insects (drosophila), plants (arabidopsis), fungi (yeast), bacteria, and archaea.

We subjected these genomes to uncompromising filtering (true reading frames only, strict alternate genetic code accounting) and tested them against a brutal ladder of 10 Null Models (from H0 to H7, including H2b and H3b). These involve highly complex tests for folded nucleotide dynamics, block-shuffling of local ties, and mirror symmetry preservation, which completely rule out any chance of statistical coincidence.

📊 OUR MAJOR DISCOVERIES (which we invite you to verify):

Syntax exists in ALL of them: Hidden inside the real coding sequences of ALL 13 species is a strict conditional syntax that confidently survives after passing through all 10 mathematical filters. This syntax maintains its structure over a distance of about 30 codons (≈ 90 base pairs). This is not a random scale-it represents the exact size of a local working buffer (cache) within which the biological machine reads and executes the dynamic program of the genome.
 
Macro-level (The Unified Vertebrate OS): We identified a conserved layer of syntax inherited across all tested vertebrates (20 out of 20 internal directed pairs among human, chimp, mouse, chicken, and zebrafish crossed the strict d2b > 0.02 threshold).

Micro-level (The Exclusive Mammalian Code): At the level of fine codon choice, we found a unique core conserved exclusively among mammals (human/chimp/mouse). Notably, it exhibits directional asymmetry: mouse surrogate models cannot fully reproduce the complex syntax of humans and chimps.

Evolution vs. "Hardware" Artifacts: Our algorithm (GC3/acidic control) learned to mathematically distinguish true evolutionary divergence from hardware incompatibility due to extreme genome composition (like in the haloarchaeon H. salinarum with its extreme GC3 = 0.863).

💻 WE ARE OPEN-SOURCING EVERYTHING!

We don't ask you to just take our word for it. Science must be open, provable, and verifiable. We are releasing our entire pipeline (v13)! The process is completely autonomous. A single command 

python3 super_codon_autonomous_v13.py --full 

allows the script to download the necessary files directly from NCBI RefSeq, apply filters, train models, run bootstrap analyses, and generate final reports. No hidden data, full transparency!

We are issuing a challenge to the entire scientific community. Bioinformaticians, geneticists, data scientists worldwide-download the code, run it on your machines, tweak the parameters, and test it on other living species.

Verify our findings. Try to refute us!

🔗 Preprint, Data & Source Code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23287684

#GENOMES #NCBI
